ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   D. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..

7. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   C. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.
   B. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.
   B. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.
   B. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Iman and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Milad un-Nabi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic alphabet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
